item.title: Traffic smooth on Jammu–Srinagar Highway as weather improves
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 12: Vehicular traffic is plying smoothly on both sides of the Jammu–Srinagar National Highway on Monday following an improvement in weather conditions, officials said. There was no report of slow movement or congestion on the strategic highway, with traffic moving steadily from both the Jammu and Kashmir ends. Authorities said the improvement in weather had contributed to better road conditions, allowing uninterrupted movement of passenger vehicles as well as essential supply trucks

item.title: Dense Fog delays three morning Flights in Jammu
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 12: Cold weather conditions prevailed across Jammu on Monday morning, with dense fog reducing visibility and affecting normal life and transport movement, officials said. item.title: Kashmir Gamer Fauz-e-Azeem Nominated for Krafton Esports India Awards
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 12:Fauz-e-Azeem, a talented Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) player from Kashmir, has made history by becoming the first gamer from the region to receive a nomination at the national-level Krafton Esports India Awards. He has been nominated in the Rookie Esports Player of the Year category for his outstanding performances in major BGMI tournaments. item.title: A mother’s blanket of love drapes martyred BSF constable’s statue
item.description: Jammu: A winter blanket draped over the statue of BSF constable Gurnam Singh, who laid down his life fighting terrorists in 2016 at the age of 26, has become a symbol of a mother’s eternal love for her child and touched hearts across the country. The statue, enclosed in a glass frame at Shaheed Gurnam Chowk, stands as a symbol of courage and sacrifice in his hometown in the R S Pura sector of Jammu. item.title: Kashmir in grip of cold wave, Shopian coldest place at – 8.6 °C
item.description: Srinagar: Cold wave conditions in Kashmir intensified as minimum temperature settled several degrees below freezing point, officials said on Sunday. The sub-zero temperature and clear skies resulted in the freezing of parts of the Dal Lake and other water bodies. Srinagar recorded a minimum temperature of minus 5.2 degrees Celsius on Saturday night, slight up from the previous night’s minus 5.7 degrees Celsius. item.description: NAVVNEET DUBEY Jammu: Jammu & Kashmir is preparing for the Census 2027, with a Union Territory-level Census Coordination Committee set to determine a 30-day window for house listing operations (HLO) between April 1 and September 30. item.title: Forces opposing Somnath rebuilding still active, need to defeat them, says PM Modi
item.description: Gujarat: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday said the forces that had opposed the reconstruction of the Somnath temple after independence are “still active among us”, and India needs to be alert, united and strong to defeat them.
